data.name: Jayaprada
data.gender_notes: Jayaprada is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaya (victory) + Prada (bestowed). The name Jayaprada is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a popular Hindu name for girls. It symbolizes victory over troubles and the bestowal of success. The name Jayaprada carries the meaning “Victory over troubles” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayaprada usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over troubles and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayaprada total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
